Bug-01 | Story:US-01 | NPE on null string | Fixed:if(s==null) return null; | Buggy:return s.toUpperCase();
Bug-02 | Story:US-08 | Infinite loop if width is 0 | Fixed:if(w<1) w=1; | Buggy:while(i < str.length())
Bug-03 | Story:US-05 | Off-by-one in reverse | Fixed:i < len / 2 | Buggy:i <= len / 2
Bug-04 | Story:US-07 | Hex 0x prefix not handled | Fixed:Integer.decode(s) | Buggy:Integer.parseInt(s)
Bug-05 | Story:US-02 | Tab not treated as blank | Fixed:cs.charAt(i) <= 32 | Buggy:cs.charAt(i) == ' '
Bug-06 | Story:US-13 | Overlapping matches not counted | Fixed:i += 1 | Buggy:i += sub.length()
Bug-07 | Story:US-06 | Escaped chars cause crash | Fixed:Pattern.quote(r) | Buggy:Pattern.compile(r)
Bug-08 | Story:US-12 | Missing support for Cyrillic | Fixed:Unicode normalize | Buggy:replace('é','e')
Bug-09 | Story:US-09 | Case insensitive fails on null | Fixed:s1 != null && s1.equalsIgnoreCase(s2) | Buggy:s1.equalsIgnoreCase(s2)
Bug-10 | Story:US-03 | Negative limit allowed | Fixed:if(limit < 0) throw error; | Buggy:substring(0, limit)
Bug-11 | Story:US-11 | Padding negative count | Fixed:Math.max(0, count) | Buggy:new char[count]
Bug-12 | Story:US-14 | Mixed case swap error | Fixed:isUpper ? toLower : toUpper | Buggy:toLower()
Bug-13 | Story:US-15 | Palindrome fails on spaces | Fixed:s.replace(" ","") | Buggy:s.equals(reverse)
Bug-14 | Story:US-08 | Hardcoded line separator | Fixed:System.lineSeparator() | Buggy:"\n"
Bug-15 | Story:US-01 | Lowercase char missed | Fixed:Character.toTitleCase | Buggy:Character.toUpperCase
Bug-16 | Story:US-10 | Empty tag returns whole string | Fixed:if(open.isEmpty()) return ""; | Buggy:substring(open, close)
Bug-17 | Story:US-07 | Case sensitivity in true/false | Fixed:equalsIgnoreCase("true") | Buggy:equals("true")
Bug-18 | Story:US-05 | Null array crash | Fixed:if(a==null) return; | Buggy:len = a.length
Bug-19 | Story:US-01 | Single char strings fail | Fixed:if(len < 2) return in.upper(); | Buggy:substring(1)
Bug-20 | Story:US-02 | Empty string is not blank | Fixed:return len == 0 || blank; | Buggy:return blank;
